name: opencode
install: export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"; export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"; command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 || curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash -s "bun-v1.3.14"; "$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bun" install

terminals.name: opencode-server
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; cd /agent/repos/opencode && bun dev serve --port 4096 --hostname 0.0.0.0
terminals.description: OpenCode headless API server; also serves the web UI at http://localhost:4096
